# Cryogenic Power Diode Measurements

- **Dataset:** Cryogenic and Superconducting Power Electronics Database
- **Source:** https://doi.org/10.57745/2AHLA6
- **Authors/organization:** GeePs, CentraleSupélec, Université Paris-Saclay
- **License:** Etalab Open License 2.0
- **Data type:** Experimental diode current-voltage (I–V) measurements
- **Temperatures:** 293 K and 77 K, where provided
- **File format:** CSV files and associated PNG plots

## Processing notes

Original downloaded files are retained separately from processed data. Before using measurements, inspect the CSV headers, units, device technology, and any manually adjusted data points. Do not treat the two temperature measurements as the same operating condition.

This dataset is not yet integrated into the project's training data.
